```{r, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE, include=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(plotly)
library(fivethirtyeight) 

candy <- fivethirtyeight::candy_rankings
# count(candy, type)
```

## Row 2

```{r}
scatter <- ggplot(candy,
  aes(
    pricepercent,
    winpercent,
    text = competitorname
  )
) +
  geom_point(size = 1) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    title = "Best Bang for Your Buck",
    x = "Price %",
    y = "Win %")

ggplotly(scatter, tooltip = "text")

candy <- candy |>
  mutate(
    value_score = winpercent / (pricepercent + 0.01)
  )
```

```{r}
best_value <- candy |>
  arrange(desc(value_score)) |>
  select(
    competitorname,
    pricepercent,
    winpercent,
    value_score
  ) |>
  slice_head(n = 10)

knitr::kable(best_value, col.names = c(
    "Candy Name",
    "Price %",
    "Win %",
    "Value Score"))
```
